town.title: Warden's Town
ending.1:
The heart carried up from the bottom of the spiral
stopped beating quietly before the gate of the graveyard.
ending.2:
Riine took her master's lantern
and rolled up the sleeves of her oversized cloak.
ending.3:
“From today, I am the Warden.
... I will see the dead of the spiral off properly.”
ending.4:
The dead of the spiral lie quiet.
But the stone heart is not whole. Its missing piece points far away -
to a city drowned beneath the water.
ending.end: — Part I: The Warden's Spiral, The End —
